adjudication.rationale: The diff changes GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent/deleteEvent to compute the target calendar ID as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. In the else-branch, `externalCalendarId` is falsy (typically `undefined`/`null`), so the predicate becomes `cal.externalId === undefined`, which will not match any normal destination calendar entry.
